# Deliverable C: Detailed Storyboard

Every shot of the film with the 13 fields required by the brief (shot number, duration, camera position, lens, movement, framing, action, lighting, environmental motion, visual effects, sound, dialogue, transition), plus timecodes and the continuity state of every principal in the shot.

Timecodes: **REC** is the film timecode (picture start 01:00:00:00); **SEQ** is the position inside the sequence (mm:ss:ff). 24 fps. Frame ranges are inclusive start, exclusive end.

Sequence 1 has rendered storyboard frames from the prototype (see [`../F_prototype.md`](../F_prototype.md) and `output/s01_prototype/storyboard/`).
